name: @yadacoin/password-manager
description: YadaCoin password manager — shared core, themed UI, browser extension, mobile shell

scripts.build: npm run build -w @yadacoin/password-core && npm run build -w @yadacoin/password-shared-ui && npm run build -w @yadacoin/password-extension && npm run build -w @yadacoin/password-mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @yadacoin/password-core && npm run typecheck -w @yadacoin/password-shared-ui
